opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, not eligible for other tuition fee support, must have an unconditional offer or be a continuing student on a full‑time, part‑time or distance‑learning undergraduate degree for academic year 2026‑27 at an eligible Scottish higher education institution, and meet residency and immigration criteria.
opportunities.summary: Grants to cover tuition fees up to £1,820 per year for eligible undergraduate students from low‑income households who are not eligible for government tuition fee support.
